package plantedsplit

import "github.com/margince/margince/backend/internal/platform/httperr"

var declared = &httperr.DetailedError{}

func fillDeclared() { declared.Code = "planted_split_var" }

func fillAsserted(err error) { err.(*httperr.DetailedError).Code = "planted_split_asserted" }

func fillAssertedLocal(err error) {
	refusal := err.(*httperr.DetailedError)
	refusal.Code = "planted_split_asserted_local"
}

func buildAliased() *aliased { return &aliased{Code: "planted_split_aliased_literal"} }

func buildDefined() defined { return defined{Code: "planted_split_defined_literal"} }
